title: The difficulty of telling signal from noise when noise lingers
title_zh: 噪声持续时区分信号与噪声的困难
title_primary: 噪声持续时区分信号与噪声的困难
title_secondary: The difficulty of telling signal from noise when noise lingers
authors: Bhagwan Chowdhry
official: 官方在线 2026-09-08 · 来源：RSS
abstract: How many observations does it take to detect a fixed signal when the noise has long memory? For a sample-mean detector applied to a constant signal buried in fractionally integrated noise of order d ∈ [ 0,1 / 2 ) , I give a closed-form expression for the sample size required to reach a target power at a fixed size: T q ( d ) = [ ( τ + Φ − 1 ( q ) ) σ c d / ( δ x ) ] 2 / ( 1 − 2 d ) . The exponent 2 / ( 1 − 2 d ) is the whole story: the required sample size is a power function of detection difficulty whose exponent diverges as d → 1 / 2 . A doubling of detection difficulty that costs four times the data under independence costs 210 times the data at d = 0.4 . A Monte Carlo confirms the formula delivers the target power and size.

title: Political Patronage, Rent-Extraction, and Social Costs: Evidence from China’s Environmental Cleanup
title_zh: 政治庇护、寻租与社会成本：来自中国环境治理的证据
title_primary: 政治庇护、寻租与社会成本：来自中国环境治理的证据
title_secondary: Political Patronage, Rent-Extraction, and Social Costs: Evidence from China’s Environmental Cleanup
authors: Cong Zhang, Ming Li, Fubing Su, Ran Tao
source: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
official: 官方在线 2026-09-08 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper investigates how informal political patronage subverts environmental regulation and local economic performance in China. We demonstrate that patronage provides local officials with political insurance, enabling them to safely shield polluting firms from top-down enforcement. Contrary to the promotion tournament hypothesis, this forbearance does not drive GDP growth. Instead, it is sustained through localized rent extraction. Utilizing firm-level data and shocks induced by provincial party secretary turnover, we find that connected officials extract a political tax, measured via perk expenditures, from both polluting and non-polluting enterprises. This systemic extortion generates broad negative spillovers: while shielding incumbent polluters, patronage crowds out productive investment and deters clean market entrants, ultimately degrading both environmental outcomes and the regional business environment.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了非正式政治庇护如何在中国颠覆环境规制及地方经济表现。我们证明，庇护为地方官员提供了政治保险，使其能够安全地庇护污染企业免受自上而下的执法。与晋升锦标赛假说相反，这种纵容并未推动GDP增长。相反，它通过地方化的租金抽取得以维持。利用企业层面数据及省委书记更替引发的冲击，我们发现，关联官员通过额外津贴支出衡量的政治税收，从污染与非污染企业中抽取。这种系统性勒索产生了广泛的负面溢出效应：在庇护现有污染者的同时，庇护行为挤出了生产性投资，阻碍了清洁市场进入者，最终同时恶化了环境成果与区域商业环境。

title: Dynamic Investment and Product Market Rivalry: the Network Q Model
title_zh: 动态投资与产品市场竞争：网络Q模型
title_primary: 动态投资与产品市场竞争：网络Q模型
title_secondary: Dynamic Investment and Product Market Rivalry: the Network Q Model
authors: M. Cecilia Bustamante, Bruno Pellegrino
official: 官方在线 2026-09-03 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We present a new dynamic model of corporate investment in imperfectly competitive product markets that extends the neoclassical (Q) theory of capital to accommodate heterogeneous, multi-product firms and a rich hedonic demand system. Our model endogenizes firms' markups and generalizes Tobin's Q to a matrix (or network) of product market spillovers, which captures how each firm's investment affects that of its rivals. We provide equilibrium existence and uniqueness results along with global analytical solutions for the firms' investment policies. We then take our model to the data for the universe of US public companies and obtain four novel insights: 1) product market competition is a key driver of aggregate investment and capital allocation; 2) shocks to firms' cost of capital generate highly heterogeneous investment and markup responses across firms, and thus impact industry concentration; 3) monopoly rents account for a large, rising share of firms' value; 4) mergers consummated since 1995 have led to a modest decline in the aggregate capital formation of merging firms, yet firm-level markup increases have been highly heterogeneous.

title: The generative AI learning penalty in secondary school
title_zh: 中学阶段生成式人工智能学习的不利影响
title_primary: 中学阶段生成式人工智能学习的不利影响
title_secondary: The generative AI learning penalty in secondary school
authors: David Strömberg, Victor Lei, Yanhui Wu
official: 官方在线 2026-09-04 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Generative AT tools can help students complete assignments faster and achieve better scores. But completing these tasks is not the goal; learning from them is. This column uses data on over 25,000 7th to 12th grade students in China to examine how self-directed use of generative AI affects their learning. Time spent on homework for students who used AI went down and homework scores went up, but their exam scores fell. While the initial effect is small, it grows as students become more proficient with AI tools and as more course material is learned after adoption, suggesting that existing short-duration studies may underestimate the long-run learning costs of using generative AI.
abstract_zh: 生成式人工智能工具能帮助学生更快完成作业并取得更高分数。然而，完成这些任务并非目的，从中学习才是关键。本文基于中国超过25,000名7至12年级学生的数据，考察了自主使用生成式人工智能对其学习的影响。使用人工智能的学生在作业上花费的时间减少，作业成绩有所提升，但他们的考试成绩却出现下降。尽管初始影响较小，但随着学生对人工智能工具熟练度的提高以及采用后学习更多课程材料，这一影响逐渐增大，这表明现有短期研究可能低估了使用生成式人工智能的长期学习成本。

title: Cryptocurrency Uncertainty and Bank Intermediation
title_zh: 加密货币不确定性与银行中介
title_primary: 加密货币不确定性与银行中介
title_secondary: Cryptocurrency Uncertainty and Bank Intermediation
authors: Whelsy Boungou, Alhonita Yatie
official: 官方在线 2026-09-02 · 来源：RSS
abstract: The rapid expansion of cryptocurrency markets has intensified interactions between digital assets and traditional financial institutions, raising important questions about the implications of cryptocurrency-related uncertainty for banking activities. This paper investigates how cryptocurrency uncertainty shapes banks' funding, lending, and risk-taking decisions. Using a panel of 8,330 banks across 129 countries over the period 2009–2018, we examine the relationship between cryptocurrency uncertainty and key dimensions of banks' balance-sheet decisions. We find that heightened cryptocurrency uncertainty increases customer deposits while reducing lending activity, non-performing loans, and risk-weighted assets. These findings suggest that banks respond to cryptocurrency uncertainty by adopting more conservative balance-sheet decisions characterized by stronger funding positions, lower credit expansion, and reduced risk exposure. The results remain robust to alternative measures of cryptocurrency uncertainty and lending activity. Our findings highlight that cryptocurrency uncertainty generates significant spillover effects on traditional financial intermediation and should be incorporated into macroprudential surveillance frameworks.
abstract_zh: 加密货币市场的迅速扩张加剧了数字资产与传统金融机构之间的互动，引发了关于加密货币相关不确定性对银行业活动影响的重要问题。本文探讨了加密货币不确定性如何影响银行的融资、贷款及风险承担决策。利用2009年至2018年间覆盖129个国家8，330家银行的面板数据，我们考察了加密货币不确定性与银行资产负债表决策关键维度之间的关系。研究发现，加密货币不确定性的上升增加了客户存款，同时减少了贷款活动、不良贷款及风险加权资产。这些结果表明，银行通过采取更为保守的资产负债表决策来应对加密货币不确定性，其特征为更强的资金状况、更低的信贷扩张及减少的风险敞口。上述结果在采用替代性加密货币不确定性及贷款活动衡量指标后依然稳健。我们的发现强调，加密货币不确定性对传统金融中介产生了显著的溢出效应，应被纳入宏观审慎监管框架之中。

title: Beyond exposure: Predicting AI adoption based on comparative advantage
title_zh: 超越接触：基于比较优势预测人工智能采纳
title_primary: 超越接触：基于比较优势预测人工智能采纳
title_secondary: Beyond exposure: Predicting AI adoption based on comparative advantage
authors: Ilse Lindenlaub, Ryungha Oh, Maria Alejandra Rodriguez, Laura Veldkamp
official: 官方在线 2026-08-30 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Predictions about the workplace impact of artificial intelligence often begin with what the technology can do captured by occupations’ exposure to AI. Using representative data on German workers, this column shows that adoption also depends on whether AI is worth using relative to human labour. Comparative advantage is a much better predictor of AI adoption than absolute advantage based on exposure alone.
abstract_zh: 关于人工智能对职场影响的预测，往往始于技术能力，即通过职业对AI的暴露程度来衡量。利用德国工人的代表性数据，本专栏表明，AI的采纳还取决于相对于人类劳动，使用AI是否值得。比较优势比仅基于暴露度的绝对优势更能预测AI的采纳情况。

title: Human accuracy in social network analysis: The role of network characteristics in infection risk assessment
title_zh: 社会网络分析中的人类准确性：网络特征在感染风险评估中的作用
title_primary: 社会网络分析中的人类准确性：网络特征在感染风险评估中的作用
title_secondary: Human accuracy in social network analysis: The role of network characteristics in infection risk assessment
authors: Martijn Stroom, Roselinde Kessels, Ingrid Rohde, Martin Strobel
source: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-28 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Understanding an individual’s human network assessment is fundamental for successful policy design when dealing with infection risk. Yet, how individuals cognitively compensate for their inability to process complex network models, remains poorly understood. Using an online best-worst ranking experiment, we investigate individuals’ perception of the risk of connecting to carefully constructed COVID-19-infected networks of 697 Dutch participants. Specifically, we consider three network characteristics that individuals can either directly access or implicitly estimate in real-life social network assessment. We show that the perceived infection risk in social networks is not solely based on the objective probability of this risk: easily assessable physical characteristics have stronger predictive power on the perceived risk than the objective probability. Heterogeneity assessment suggests that demographic differences such as the level of education interact with the order and strength of the network characteristics. The often-complex mental calculation underlying objective risk in networks is substituted by a heuristics-driven approach. Our findings facilitate more tailored, effective, and generalizable policy and economically optimal infection-mitigating campaign design.
abstract_zh: 理解个体的人际网络评估对于制定应对感染风险的有效政策至关重要。然而，个体如何在认知上弥补其处理复杂网络模型能力的不足，仍鲜为人知。通过一项在线最优-最差排序实验，我们调查了697名荷兰参与者对连接精心构建的COVID-19感染网络风险的感知。具体而言，我们考虑了三种个体在现实社交网络评估中可直接获取或隐含估计的网络特征。我们表明，社交网络中的感知感染风险并非仅基于该风险的客观概率：易于评估的物理特征对感知风险的预测力强于客观概率。异质性评估表明，教育水平等人口统计学差异与网络特征的作用顺序和强度相互作用。网络客观风险背后通常复杂的心理计算被一种基于启发式的方法所取代。我们的发现有助于设计更具针对性、有效且可推广的政策，以及经济上最优的感染缓解宣传活动。

title: The Economy of People’s Republic of China from 1953
title_zh: 1953年以来中华人民共和国的经济
title_primary: 1953年以来中华人民共和国的经济
title_secondary: The Economy of People’s Republic of China from 1953
authors: Anton Cheremukhin, Mikhail Golosov, Sergei Guriev, Aleh Tsyvinski, Gaaitzen de Vries 等
official: 官方在线 2015-08-04 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper studies growth and structural transformation of the Chinese economy from 1953 to 2012 through a lens of a two‐sector growth model. The main goal of the paper is to provide a systematic analysis of both the pre‐1978 reform and post‐1978 reform periods in a unified framework. First, we construct a dataset that allows the application of the neoclassical model and computation of wedges, their components, and rates of TFP growth. Second, we determine the key quantitative factors behind growth and structural transformation. The changes in the intersectoral labor wedge play the dominant role in accounting for the change in the share of labor force in agriculture. TFP growth and changes in the intersectoral wedges are the two most significant factors contributing to GDP growth. Further decomposing the effects of reduction in wedges, we find that two components: the production component (the gap between the ratio of the marginal products of labor and relative wages) and the consumption component (the gap between the marginal rate of substitution and the relative prices) play a particularly large role. Third, we use the pre‐reform period as a key benchmark to measure the success of the post‐1978 reforms. We show that reforms yielded a significant growth and structural transformation differential. GDP growth is 4.2 percentage points higher and the share of the labor force in agriculture is 23.9 percentage points lower compared with the continuation of the pre‐1978 policies. We provide extensive historical evidence for the reforms that are consistent with the evolution of the components of the wedges. The decrease in the production component of the intersectoral wedge is consistent with increased competition and demonopolization of the economy. The decrease in the consumption component of the wedge is consistent with the price and housing reforms. Finally, we project the path of the Chinese economy until 2050 and also calculate a lower bound on future growth by projecting pre‐reform trends.
abstract_zh: 本文通过两部门增长模型的视角，研究了中国经济从1953年至2012年的增长与结构转型。本文的主要目标是在统一框架下，对1978年改革前及改革后两个时期进行系统性分析。首先，我们构建了一个数据集，使得新古典模型的应用及楔子、其组成部分及全要素生产率增长率的计算成为可能。其次，我们确定了增长与结构转型背后的关键量化因素。部门间劳动力楔子的变化在解释农业劳动力份额变化中起着主导作用。全要素生产率增长与部门间楔子的变化是促进GDP增长的两个最重要因素。进一步分解楔子减少的影响，我们发现两个组成部分：生产组成部分（劳动力边际产品比率与相对工资之间的差距）和消费组成部分（边际替代率与相对价格之间的差距）发挥了特别重要的作用。第三，我们以改革前时期作为关键基准，来衡量1978年后改革成功的程度。我们表明，改革带来了显著的增长与结构转型差异。与延续1978年前政策相比，GDP增长率高出4.2个百分点，农业劳动力份额低23.9个百分点。我们提供了广泛的历史证据，证明改革与楔子各组成部分的演变相一致。部门间楔子生产组成部分的下降与经济竞争加剧及去垄断化相符。楔子消费组成部分的下降与价格及住房改革相符。最后，我们预测了中国经济直至2050年的路径，并通过预测改革前趋势，计算了未来增长的下限。

title: Religion and Conflict: Evidence from China, 1860–1911
title_zh: 宗教与冲突：来自中国1860—1911年的证据
title_primary: 宗教与冲突：来自中国1860—1911年的证据
title_secondary: Religion and Conflict: Evidence from China, 1860–1911
authors: Yujing Huang, Chicheng Ma, Felipe Valencia Caicedo
official: 官方在线 2026-03-10 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper examines the economic origins and consequences of anti-missionary violence during the late Qing China (1860–1911). Using newly digitized data, we find that conflicts were attenuated by economic complementarities — such as access to Treaty Ports and public goods — rather than triggered by religious competition with Confucian elites. On the consequences part, we document negative economic spillovers of anti-missionary conflicts, through reduced foreign and domestic investments in modern firms and banks. These negative outcomes were reinforced by Western media coverage and persist today through lower FDI flows and increased autarkic attitudes among residents.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了晚清时期（1860-1911年）反传教士暴力的经济根源及其后果。利用新近数字化的数据，我们发现冲突因经济互补性——如通商口岸的可及性和公共品的提供——而有所缓和，而非由与儒家精英的宗教竞争所触发。在后果方面，我们记录了反传教士冲突通过减少外资及国内对现代企业和银行的投入，产生了负面的经济溢出效应。这些负面结果因西方媒体的报道而加剧，并持续至今，表现为较低的外商直接投资流入和居民中增强的自给自足倾向。

title: Learning to See the World's Opportunities: Memory, Mental Experiencing, and the Economic Lives of the Vulnerable
title_zh: 学会看见世界的机会：记忆、心理体验与弱势群体的经济生活
title_primary: 学会看见世界的机会：记忆、心理体验与弱势群体的经济生活
title_secondary: Learning to See the World's Opportunities: Memory, Mental Experiencing, and the Economic Lives of the Vulnerable
authors: Nava Ashraf, Gharad Bryan, Alexia Delfino, Emily Holmes, Leonardo Iacovone 等
official: 官方在线 2025-01-23 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Many of the world's poor have experienced trauma. We argue that memories of this trauma interfere with the process of future simulation, diminishing the ability to see how actions today can improve outcomes tomorrow. We introduce guided mental experiencing (GME) -- an intervention in which participants mentally simulate pathways between their actions and desired economic outcomes -- as a response, and study GME's impact in two RCTs. In a population of Eritrean refugees in Ethiopia, GME increases the ability of refugees to see a positive future, increases their intent to stay in Ethiopia, increases labor force participation and improves self-reported welfare. In a population that has experienced violence and poverty in Colombia, a traditional entrepreneurial training program reduces the ability to imagine a future in business and worsens economic outcomes. Integrating GME into entrepreneurial training restores future thinking and removes these negative economic effects. The largest gains accrue to the most traumatized participants in our samples.
abstract_zh: 世界上许多贫困人口都曾经历过创伤。我们认为，这些创伤的记忆会干扰未来模拟的过程，削弱个体认识到今日行动如何能改善明日结果的能力。我们引入引导式心理体验（GME）——一种干预措施，参与者在此过程中心理模拟从自身行动到期望经济结果之间的路径——作为应对方案，并在两项随机对照试验（RCT）中研究GME的影响。在埃塞俄比亚的厄立特里亚难民群体中，GME增强了难民展望积极未来的能力，提高了他们留在埃塞俄比亚的意愿，增加了劳动力参与率，并改善了自我报告的福利状况。在哥伦比亚经历过暴力与贫困的人群中，传统的创业培训项目降低了他们想象商业未来的能力，并使经济结果恶化。将GME整合进创业培训中，则恢复了未来思维，并消除了这些负面经济影响。在我们的样本中，获益最大的是那些受创伤最严重的参与者。

title: Why Not Tax It? The effects of property taxes on house prices and homeownership
title_zh: 为何不征税？房产税对房价与住房自有率的影响
title_primary: 为何不征税？房产税对房价与住房自有率的影响
title_secondary: Why Not Tax It? The effects of property taxes on house prices and homeownership
authors: Francesco Chiocchio
official: 官方在线 2026-08-12 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Owner-occupied housing is exempt from property taxes in many countries. How does this exemption affect house prices, homeownership, and welfare? And if owner-occupied housing were taxed, should the tax be progressive? To address these questions, I develop a life-cycle model of homeownership with heterogeneous agents in which property taxation affects both the cost of owning and renting through the taxation of real-estate firms. I calibrate the model to match key features of a housing market with an owner-occupied exemption and a regressive effective property tax schedule. I study revenue-neutral reforms that remove the exemption and vary tax progressivity. Eliminating the exemption increases property tax revenues by over 1.2 percentage points of GDP but reduces homeownership substantially. However, moving to a flat or progressive property tax offsets part of this decline while still generating sizable revenue gains. These reforms improve long-run welfare for new generations, particularly for lower-income households, but reduce the welfare of households alive at the time of the reform, highlighting underlying political tensions.
abstract_zh: 在许多国家，自有住房免征房产税。这一免税政策如何影响房价、住房拥有率及社会福利？若对自有住房征税，该税种是否应具有累进性？为解答这些问题，我构建了一个包含异质性代理人的生命周期住房拥有模型，其中房产税通过对房地产企业征税，同时影响购房与租赁成本。我将模型校准至与一个实行自有住房免税及累退性有效房产税税制的住房市场关键特征相匹配。我研究了取消免税并调整税收累进性的收入中性改革方案。取消免税将使房产税收入增加超过GDP的1.2个百分点，但会显著降低住房拥有率。然而，转向统一税率或累进性房产税可在部分抵消这一下降的同时，仍带来可观的收入增长。这些改革提升了新一代人的长期福利，尤其是对低收入家庭，但降低了改革时在世家庭的福利，凸显了潜在的政治张力。

title: Strategic corporate social responsibility and merger decisions
title_zh: 战略性企业社会责任与并购决策
title_primary: 战略性企业社会责任与并购决策
title_secondary: Strategic corporate social responsibility and merger decisions
authors: Cunha, Mariana, Mota, Filipa
official: 官方在线 2026-08-11 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper investigates the conditions under which mergers between corporate social responsibility (CSR) firms are both privately profitable and socially desirable. We develop a Cournot model of quantity competition with product differentiation, featuring both CSR and non-CSR firms. CSR firms engage in observable CSR investment, which affects consumer willingness to pay depending on the level of CSR cognition in the market. We analyse a two-stage game in which CSR firms decide whether to propose a merger and a (myopic) Antitrust Authority (AA) determines whether to authorise it. Our results show that the profitability and approval of such mergers crucially depend on the degree of product differentiation and consumer sensitivity to CSR. When products are sufficiently complementary (or weakly substitutable) and CSR awareness is high, the merger increases both firm profits and consumer surplus, leading to regulatory approval. However, when the merger induces the exit of non-CSR competitors and products are homogeneous, a divergence emerges between private and social incentives, with the AA often blocking otherwise profitable mergers. These findings provide novel insights into merger policy design in settings where ethical competition and market power coexist.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了企业社会责任（CSR）企业之间的合并既具有私人盈利性又具有社会合意性的条件。我们构建了一个包含产品差异化的数量竞争古诺模型，其中同时包含CSR企业与非CSR企业。CSR企业进行可观察的CSR投资，该投资根据市场中CSR认知水平影响消费者的支付意愿。我们分析了一个两阶段博弈，其中CSR企业决定是否提议合并，而（短视的）反垄断机构（AA）决定是否批准该合并。我们的结果表明，此类合并的盈利性与批准与否关键取决于产品差异化程度和消费者对CSR的敏感度。当产品充分互补（或弱替代）且CSR意识较高时，合并既增加企业利润又提升消费者剩余，从而获得监管批准。然而，当合并导致非CSR竞争对手退出且产品同质时，私人激励与社会激励之间出现分歧，反垄断机构往往阻止原本有利可图的合并。这些发现为在伦理竞争与市场力量并存的背景下设计合并政策提供了新颖见解。

title: Do people get used to working long hours?
title_zh: 人们是否习惯了长时间工作？
title_primary: 人们是否习惯了长时间工作？
title_secondary: Do people get used to working long hours?
authors: Krekel, Christian, Kremser, Tim, Melios, Georgios
official: 官方在线 2026-09-30 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Overemployment – working more hours than desired – affects nearly one-third of European workers, yet its consequences remain understudied. Using data from the German Socio-Economic Panel (SOEP, 1984-2019, N = 43,570) and individual fixed-effects models with leads and lags, we examine whether overemployment is associated with a deterioration in wellbeing and health, and whether potential adverse impacts persist as long as the overemployment state continues or whether people get used to working long hours. We find that overemployment is associated with a substantial decline in mental health, with impacts that intensify rather than attenuate over time. Specifically, the SF-12 mental health summary scale declines by 0.44 points in the first year of overemployment, deepening to between 0.80 and 1.13 points (8–11% of a standard deviation) thereafter. We obtain similar results for work, leisure time, health, and overall life satisfaction. Meanwhile, the association between overemployment and physical health is smaller and less consistent. Our findings suggest that overemployment may lead to an increased risk of persistent symptoms of poor mental health and low wellbeing, with implications for working time regulations and workplace wellbeing and health policies.
abstract_zh: 过度就业——即工作时间超出个人期望——影响了近三分之一的欧洲劳动者，然而其后果仍未得到充分研究。利用德国社会经济面板数据（SOEP，1984-2019年，N=43,570）以及包含前置和滞后项的个体固定效应模型，我们考察了过度就业是否与身心健康恶化相关，以及潜在的不利影响是否在过度就业状态持续期间长期存在，还是人们会逐渐适应长时间工作。我们发现，过度就业与心理健康显著下降相关，且这种影响随时间推移而加剧而非减弱。具体而言，SF-12心理健康综合评分在过度就业的第一年下降0.44分，此后进一步加深至0.80至1.13分（标准差幅度的8%至11%）。我们在工作、闲暇时间、健康及整体生活满意度方面也获得了类似结果。与此同时，过度就业与身体健康之间的关联较小且一致性较弱。我们的研究结果表明，过度就业可能导致持续的心理健康不良和低幸福感症状风险增加，这对工作时间规制以及职场健康与福祉政策具有重要启示。

title: Modelling the Effects of Tariffs and Non‐Tariff Measures on Agricultural Products: Evidence From a Developing Country
title_zh: 关税与非关税措施对农产品影响的建模：来自发展中国家的证据
title_primary: 关税与非关税措施对农产品影响的建模：来自发展中国家的证据
title_secondary: Modelling the Effects of Tariffs and Non‐Tariff Measures on Agricultural Products: Evidence From a Developing Country
authors: Vitor Santos, Mauricio Bittencourt
official: 官方在线 2026-08-01 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper examines how tariffs and non‐tariff measures (NTMs) imposed by Brazil's major agricultural trading partners affect the country's exports at the country–product level over the period 2000–2017. Using a newly assembled dataset of NTMs from the TRAINS database and a novel methodology for constructing unilateral trade flows in a single‐exporter setting, we estimate a reduced‐form Poisson pseudo‐maximum likelihood (PPML) model. The results show that tariffs exert large and consistently negative effects on export performance, while NTMs have heterogeneous impacts that depend on their economic characteristics and on the treatment of Brazilian products relative to competing exporters. We also introduce a measure of the cumulative trade frictions arising from the joint application of tariffs and NTMs, showing that multilateral NTMs substantially amplify the trade‐reducing effects of tariffs, particularly for price and quantity measures. Finally, an event‐study analysis based on the Local Projections Difference‐in‐Differences (LP‐DiD) estimator indicates that the introduction of a new NTM temporarily reduces the export share of the affected product, with recovery beginning in the third year after implementation.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了巴西主要农业贸易伙伴实施的关税与非关税措施（NTMs）如何影响该国在2000年至2017年间国家-产品层面的出口。利用从TRAINS数据库新汇编的非关税措施数据集，以及一种在单一出口国情境下构建单边贸易流的新方法，我们估计了一个简化形式的泊松伪最大似然（PPML）模型。结果表明，关税对出口绩效产生了显著且持续的负面影响，而非关税措施的影响则具有异质性，取决于其经济特征以及巴西产品相对于竞争出口国的待遇。我们还引入了一种衡量关税与非关税措施联合应用所产生的累积贸易摩擦的指标，显示多边非关税措施显著放大了关税的贸易缩减效应，尤其是对价格和数量措施而言。最后，基于局部投影双重差分（LP-DiD）估计量的事件研究分析表明，新非关税措施的引入会暂时降低受影响产品的出口份额，并在实施后第三年开始恢复。

title: Add-on selling with context effects
title_zh: 基于情境效应的附加销售
title_primary: 基于情境效应的附加销售
title_secondary: Add-on selling with context effects
authors: Philipp Brunner, Christian Zihlmann
source: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
official: 来源期次 2026-08-01 · 来源：RSS
abstract: A common practice is to offer optional extras or upgrades during the purchase process. This paper studies endogenous consumer insensitivity to such additional prices: we posit that consumers are more prone to buy these overpriced extras when they represent a smaller share of total expenditure. The presence of such context-sensitive consumers softens competition in the market for the base good, jeopardizing their own surplus but also that of consumers with standard preferences. Exploitation of context effects by firms reduces total welfare.
abstract_zh: 一种常见做法是在购买过程中提供可选的附加服务或升级。本文研究消费者对此类附加价格的内生不敏感性：我们假设，当这些高价附加服务占总支出比例较小时，消费者更倾向于购买。这类对情境敏感的消费者的存在，削弱了基础商品市场的竞争，不仅损害了自身剩余，也损害了具有标准偏好的消费者的剩余。企业利用情境效应会降低总福利。

title: Narrow Non-Bank Financial Intermediation and Economic Growth: Does the Economic Cycle Matter?
title_zh: 狭义的影子银行中介与经济增长：经济周期是否重要？
title_primary: 狭义的影子银行中介与经济增长：经济周期是否重要？
title_secondary: Narrow Non-Bank Financial Intermediation and Economic Growth: Does the Economic Cycle Matter?
authors: Michelle Majid, Akeem Rahaman
official: 官方在线 2026-07-29 · 来源：RSS
abstract: In this paper, we examine whether the relationship between non-bank financial intermediation (NBFI) and economic growth varies across the economic cycle. While existing studies focus on the average effects of broad measures of NBFI, the effects of the narrow measure of NBFI differing during periods of economic stress is less clear. Using a panel of 26 jurisdictions participating in the Financial Stability Board's NBFI exercise between 2006 and 2024, we find that larger narrow NBFI sectors are associated with higher real GDP growth. However, we find limited evidence that this relationship varies systematically between expansionary and recessionary periods.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了非银行金融中介（NBFI）与经济增长之间的关系是否随经济周期变化。现有研究侧重于广义NBFI指标的平均效应，而狭义NBFI指标在经济压力时期的影响尚不明确。利用2006年至2024年间参与金融稳定理事会NBFI监测的26个司法管辖区的面板数据，我们发现，狭义NBFI部门规模越大，实际GDP增长率越高。然而，我们发现的证据有限，表明这种关系在扩张期与衰退期之间存在系统性差异。

title: When Democracy Falters: A Multidisciplinary, Multi-book Review Essay on Polarization, Populism, and Authoritarianism

authors: Betsey Stevenson
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This multi-book review argues that identity-driven polarization interacts with institutional design to erode democratic guardrails. Reading Heather Cox Richardson’s Democracy Awakening, Tom Schaller, and Paul Waldman’s White Rural Rage, and Ezra Klein’s Why We’re Polarized through an economist’s lens, I emphasize two claims. First, when institutions fail to deliver broadly shared security and dignity, anti-pluralist projects gain legitimacy and room to maneuver. Second, questions of belonging, citizenship, and the obligations of government to the people are informed by culture and institutional trust. The culture of the United States is not one that lends itself readily to ethno-nationalism, but these books make a case for an America that is, and perhaps has always, been divided by notions of who “we” are. I situate the books within the economics literature on populism, polarization, and institutions, and examine what we can learn about rebuilding both prosperity and democratic resilience in the United States. (JEL D02, D72, D91, J11, J15, Z13)

authors: Anthony Venables, Diego Puga, Esther Delesalle, Florian Mayneris, William Parienté 等
official: 官方在线 1998-01-31 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper analyses a model of economic development in which international inequalities in the location of industry and income are supported by the agglomeration of industry in a subset of countries. Economic development may not be a gradual process of convergence by all countries, but instead involves countries moving sequentially from the group of poor countries to the group of rich countries. The role of trade policy in promoting industrialization is studied. While both import substitution and unilateral trade liberalization may be ?successful? in attracting industry, they attract different sectors and welfare levels are higher under trade liberalization.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个经济发展模型，其中产业与收入在国际间的不平等分布，源于产业在部分国家的集聚效应。经济发展并非所有国家逐步趋同的过程，而是各国依次从贫困国家群体向富裕国家群体转移的过程。本文研究了贸易政策在促进工业化中的作用。尽管进口替代与单边贸易自由化均可能“成功”吸引产业，但二者吸引的产业部门不同，且贸易自由化下的福利水平更高。

title: The Lock-In Effect and the Corporate Payout Puzzle,
title_zh: 锁定效应与企业分红之谜
title_primary: 锁定效应与企业分红之谜
title_secondary: The Lock-In Effect and the Corporate Payout Puzzle,
authors: Chris Mitchell
source: Journal of the European Economic Association
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-24 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Taxes on capital gains are deferred until realization whereas dividends are taxed upon accrual. This often makes dividends tax disadvantaged relative to share repurchases, which leads to the payout puzzle: why do firms pay dividends? This paper demonstrates that tax deferment can also provide a solution to this puzzle: if shareholders with an accrued capital gain and a non-zero investment horizon demand a premium to sell equity—as compensation for accelerated realizations (and taxation)—then dividends can become tax efficient. This mechanism is appealing because it can explain dividend payments without appealing to asymmetric information, incomplete contracting, repurchase constraints, and/or irrationality.
abstract_zh: 资本利得税在实现时递延缴纳，而股息则在应计时征税。这通常使股息相对于股票回购处于税收劣势，从而引发"股利之谜"：企业为何仍要支付股息？本文证明，税收递延机制同样能为这一谜题提供解释：若持有已实现资本利得且投资期限非零的股东要求溢价出售股权——作为加速实现（及纳税）的补偿——则股息可能具有税收效率。该机制的优势在于，无需借助信息不对称、不完全契约、回购限制或非理性行为等假设，即可解释股息支付现象。

title: Improved Andrews’ formula for testing changing mean

abstract: We propose a robust bandwidth rule for the classical CUSUM and QS tests for shifts in the mean of a time series: the AR(1) coefficient entering Andrews’ (1991) data-driven HAC bandwidth is truncated at a fixed threshold $\rho {0} < 1$, with $\rho {0}$ selected by a simulation-based procedure that controls empirical size against a user-specified persistence robustness target. The truncated bandwidth is shown to be free from the asymptotic power reversal problem under the diverging-alternatives framework of Juhl and Xiao (2009). Monte Carlo evidence indicates that the CUSUM and QS tests implemented with this bandwidth deliver good size control and monotonic power across a range of break designs and persistence levels.
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种针对时间序列均值突变检测中经典CUSUM和QS检验的稳健带宽规则：将Andrews（1991）数据驱动的HAC带宽中涉及的AR(1)系数截断在固定阈值$\rho {0} < 1$处，其中$\rho {0}$通过基于模拟的程序选择，该程序控制经验大小以针对用户指定的持久性稳健性目标。所提出的截断带宽被证明在Juhl和Xiao（2009）的发散备择框架下避免了渐近功效反转问题。蒙特卡洛证据表明，采用此带宽实施的CUSUM和QS检验在多种断点设计和持久性水平下均能提供良好的大小控制和单调功效。

title: Medical Technology and Life Expectancy: Evidence from the Antitoxin Treatment of Diphtheria
title_zh: 医疗技术与预期寿命：白喉抗毒素治疗的证据
title_primary: 医疗技术与预期寿命：白喉抗毒素治疗的证据

official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We examine the impact of the free supply of diphtheria antitoxin, the first effective medical treatment for an infectious disease, on the historical health transition in Massachusetts. Using newly collected municipality-level data on the distribution of antitoxin and information from over 1.5 million death certificates from 1880 to 1914, we find that the rapid availability of antitoxin treatment significantly increased life expectancy at young ages. Our findings suggest that medicine, combined with an effective public health policy, played a more important role in improving life expectancy in the early twentieth century than previously thought. (JEL H75, I12, I18, J13, N31)
abstract_zh: 本文考察了白喉抗毒素（第一种针对传染病的有效医疗手段）的免费供应对马萨诸塞州历史健康转型的影响。利用新收集的市级抗毒素分配数据以及1880年至1914年间超过150万份死亡证明信息，我们发现抗毒素治疗的快速普及显著提高了低龄人群的预期寿命。研究结果表明，在20世纪初期，医学与有效的公共卫生政策相结合，对预期寿命提升的作用比以往认知更为重要。（JEL H75, I12, I18, J13, N31）

abstract: The persistent surge in U.S. inflation that began in 2021 caught forecasters and policymakers by surprise. The 2021 inflation shocks were viewed as transitory, not persistent, leading to large forecast errors in late 2021 and 2022. This paper asks whether time series models – using only data on current and past inflation, but incorporating stochastic volatility and exhibiting time-varying persistence – performed better. Univariate models, using real-time data, did not. Multivariate models, incorporating sectoral inflation measures, did.
abstract_zh: 美国自2021年开始的持续通胀飙升令预测者和政策制定者措手不及。2021年的通胀冲击被视为暂时性而非持续性，导致2021年末和2022年出现较大预测误差。本文探究仅使用当前及历史通胀数据、但纳入随机波动性并呈现时变持续性的时间序列模型是否表现更优。基于实时数据的单变量模型未能改善预测，而纳入行业通胀指标的多变量模型则表现更佳。

abstract: This paper examines how blockchain adoption affects corporate investment efficiency in China. Exploiting the staggered regional rollout of China's blockchain-based electronic invoice system as a quasi-natural experiment, we employ a difference-in-differences design and find that blockchain adoption significantly improves corporate investment efficiency. The results remain robust across a series of endogeneity and robustness tests. Mechanism analysis indicates that the effect operates primarily through improvements in financial reporting quality. Overall, our findings provide novel causal evidence on the real economic consequences of blockchain adoption and highlight the role of government-mandated information technology infrastructure in enhancing firms' resource allocation efficiency.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了区块链采纳如何影响中国企业的投资效率。利用中国基于区块链的电子发票系统分阶段区域推广作为准自然实验，我们采用双重差分设计，发现区块链采纳显著提升了企业投资效率。该结果在一系列内生性与稳健性检验中依然成立。机制分析表明，这一效应主要通过提高财务报告质量来实现。总体而言，我们的研究为区块链采纳的真实经济后果提供了新颖的因果证据，并强调了政府主导的信息技术基础设施在提升企业资源配置效率中的作用。

title: The Income Channel to Labor-Market Polarization
title_zh: 劳动力市场两极分化的收入渠道
title_primary: 劳动力市场两极分化的收入渠道
title_secondary: The Income Channel to Labor-Market Polarization
authors: Diego A. Comin, Ana Danieli, Martí Mestieri
official: 官方在线 2026-06-15 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We study labor-market polarization by developing a framework with heterogeneous consumers, non-homothetic preferences, and endogenous labor supply a la Roy (1951). Because income-elastic sectors are intensive in high- and low-skilled occupations, shocks that raise either the average or the dispersion of income across households shift relative labor demand toward these occupations, generating an income channel to polarization. We quantify this channel by comparing the effect of shocks that affect the distribution of household income in our model and in a version with homothetic preferences in which the income distribution does not affect sectoral composition. The income channel is sizable: it explains 42% and 210% of the increases in the relative wages of high- and low-skill workers observed between 1980 and 2016, and 26% and 51% of the increase in their hours-worked shares. A quarter of its effect operates through income dispersion, highlighting the importance of departing from representative-consumer frameworks in non-homothetic environments.
abstract_zh: 本文通过构建一个包含异质性消费者、非位似偏好以及罗伊（1951）式内生劳动供给的框架，研究劳动力市场的极化现象。由于收入弹性部门密集使用高技能与低技能职业，任何提升家庭平均收入或收入离散度的冲击，都会使相对劳动力需求向这些职业倾斜，从而形成极化的收入渠道。我们通过比较模型中影响家庭收入分布的冲击效应与采用位似偏好（此时收入分布不影响部门构成）版本的效应，对该渠道进行量化分析。研究显示，收入渠道影响显著：它解释了1980年至2016年间高技能与低技能工人相对工资增幅的42%和210%，以及其劳动工时占比增幅的26%和51%。其中四分之一的效应通过收入离散度发挥作用，这凸显了在非位似环境下突破代表性消费者框架的重要性。

title: Is free trade good for renewable resources? Brander and Taylor redux
title_zh: 自由贸易对可再生资源有益吗？布兰德与泰勒再探
title_primary: 自由贸易对可再生资源有益吗？布兰德与泰勒再探
title_secondary: Is free trade good for renewable resources? Brander and Taylor redux
authors: M. Scott Taylor
official: 官方在线 2026-06-18 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper generalizes the original Brander and Taylor model of open‐access renewable resource use and trade to address three common critiques. First, I introduce heterogeneity across agents in harvesting productivity to smooth out the model's extreme specialization patterns while maintaining its Ricardian structure and tractability. Second, I move beyond the original assumption of open access by constructing a policy stringency function allowing for partial, first‐best, and endogenous resource policy. Third, by exploiting the smooth substitution possibilities generated by agent heterogeneity and the insight that policy stringency functions are likely to vary across countries, I show how the model's core predictions can be evaluated using empirical methods related to those in growth econometrics.
abstract_zh: 本文对Brander和Taylor关于开放获取可再生资源利用与贸易的原始模型进行了推广，以回应三项常见批评。首先，我在采掘生产率方面引入主体异质性，在保持模型李嘉图结构与可处理性的同时，平滑了其极端专业化模式。其次，通过构建一个允许部分最优、第一最优及内生资源政策的政策严格度函数，我突破了原始模型对开放获取的假设。第三，利用主体异质性产生的平滑替代可能性以及政策严格度函数可能因国家而异的洞见，我展示了如何运用增长计量经济学相关的实证方法来评估模型的核心预测。

title: Custodial versus non-custodial sentences: Long-run evidence from an anticipated reform
title_zh: 监管刑与非监管刑：基于一项预期改革的长期证据
title_primary: 监管刑与非监管刑：基于一项预期改革的长期证据
title_secondary: Custodial versus non-custodial sentences: Long-run evidence from an anticipated reform
authors: Bastien Michel, Camille Hémet
source: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
official: 来源期次 2026-08-01 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We study the relative impact of custodial and non-custodial sentences on later crime and labor-market outcomes in Denmark, a country where detention conditions are particularly good. To do so, we take advantage of a large-scale reform of the Danish legislation implemented in 2000, whereby incarceration was replaced by a non-custodial sentence for most drunk-driving crimes, which represented a quarter of all custodial sentences passed in 1999. Our first key finding is that stakeholders anticipated the consequences of the reform and that wealthier offenders managed to postpone their trial until after the reform came into force to avoid prison. To measure the relative impact of incarceration, we therefore use a novel instrumental variable approach exploiting quasi-exogenous variation in the probability of being tried after the reform, and therefore incarcerated, based on offenders’ crime date. We follow sampled individuals over a 15-year period and find that incarcerated offenders commit more crimes and have weaker ties to the labor market after release. Additionally, first-time offenders are more negatively affected than repeat offenders.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了丹麦监禁刑与非监禁刑对后续犯罪及劳动力市场结果的相对影响，该国拘留条件尤为优越。为此，我们利用了2000年实施的一项大规模丹麦立法改革，该改革将大多数酒驾犯罪中的监禁刑替换为非监禁刑，而此类犯罪在1999年占所有监禁刑判决的四分之一。我们的首要关键发现是，利益相关者预见到了改革的后果，较富裕的罪犯设法将审判推迟至改革生效之后，以避免入狱。为衡量监禁的相对影响，我们因此采用了一种新颖的工具变量方法，利用基于罪犯犯罪日期的改革后受审概率的准外生变异，从而推断入狱概率。我们对抽样个体进行了15年的追踪，发现入狱罪犯在释放后犯罪更多，且与劳动力市场的联系更为薄弱。此外，初犯者比惯犯受到更为不利的影响。

title: Familiar strangers: The role of diaspora networks in foreign investment and long-run development
title_zh: 熟悉的陌生人：侨民网络在外资与长期发展中的作用
title_primary: 熟悉的陌生人：侨民网络在外资与长期发展中的作用
title_secondary: Familiar strangers: The role of diaspora networks in foreign investment and long-run development
authors: Fanghao Chen, Ruichi Xiong, Xiaobo Zhang
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-06 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper shows that diaspora networks played a pivotal role in directing early foreign investment to Chinese locations with weaker institutions and in catalyzing long-run industrial development. Using an administrative dataset of all foreign firms in China, we document that the post-1979 surge in foreign entry was led by diaspora firms whose legal representatives were overseas Chinese; large non-diaspora inflows arrived mainly in the late 1990s. Leveraging the staggered rolling-out of opening-up policies across prefectures during 1981-96 and employing the variation in the geographic distribution of surnames as an identification strategy, we find that diaspora firms preferentially entered prefectures likely to be their legal representatives’ ancestral origins. This pattern is stronger in contract-intensive industries and disappears around China’s WTO accession. Early diaspora entry had sizable long-run multiplier effects, attracting later non-diaspora FDI and fostering the development of industrial clusters and parks.
abstract_zh: 本文表明，侨民网络在引导早期外资流向制度环境较弱的中国地区以及促进长期工业发展方面发挥了关键作用。利用涵盖中国所有外资企业的行政数据集，我们记录了1979年后外资进入的激增主要由法定代表人系海外华人的侨民企业引领；大规模非侨民外资流入则主要出现在1990年代末。借助1981年至1996年间各城市对外开放政策分阶段推行的自然实验，并利用姓氏地理分布差异作为识别策略，我们发现侨民企业倾向于进入其法定代表人可能祖籍所在的地区。这一模式在契约密集型行业中更为显著，并在中国加入世贸组织后消失。早期侨民企业的进入产生了显著的长期乘数效应，吸引了后续非侨民直接投资，并促进了产业集群和园区的形成发展。

title: The Impact of Unions on the Wage Distribution: Evidence from Higher Education
title_zh: 工会对工资分布的影响：来自高等教育的证据
title_primary: 工会对工资分布的影响：来自高等教育的证据
title_secondary: The Impact of Unions on the Wage Distribution: Evidence from Higher Education
authors: Michael Baker, Yosh Halberstam, Kory Kroft, Alexandre Mas, Derek Messacar
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We estimate the impact of unionization on the wage distribution of Canadian university faculty using longitudinal administrative data on salaries and exploiting the staggered rollout of unionization across institutions. We find that unionization compressed salaries: Wages at the bottom of the unconditional distribution increased by roughly 10 percent, while wages at the top were unaffected. Our evidence suggests that these distributional impacts were driven by the introduction of contractual salary floors. We also estimate little impact of unionization on faculty employment. Instead, our results suggest that the increase in universities’ wage bills was financed by an increase in student enrollment. (JEL I23, J31, J45, J51)
abstract_zh: 本文利用加拿大高校教职员工薪资的纵向行政数据，并借助各院校工会化进程的阶段性推进，评估了工会化对薪资分布的影响。研究发现，工会化压缩了薪资差距：无条件薪资分布底层的工资水平上升约10%，而顶层的工资未受影响。证据表明，这种分布效应源于合同薪资下限的引入。此外，工会化对教职员工就业的影响微乎其微。相反，研究结果显示，大学薪资支出的增长是通过扩大学生招生规模来弥补的。（JEL分类号：I23, J31, J45, J51）

title: Ever since Allais
title_zh: 自阿莱以来
title_primary: 自阿莱以来
title_secondary: Ever since Allais
authors: Aluma Dembo, Shachar Kariv, Matthew Polisson, John K.-H. Quah
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: The Allais critique of expected utility theory (EUT) has led to the development of theories of choice under risk that relax the independence axiom but adhere to the fundamental/conventional axioms of ordering (completeness and transitivity) and monotonicity (with respect to first-order stochastic dominance). Unlike experimental work designed to test independence, our experiment is comprehensive, testing the entire set of axioms on which EUT is based. Our econometric analysis is also nonparametric and performed at the level of each individual subject. For the vast majority of subjects, departures from independence are small relative to departures from ordering and/or monotonicity.
abstract_zh: 阿莱斯对期望效用理论（EUT）的批评促使了风险条件下选择理论的发展，这些理论放宽了独立性公理，但坚持排序（完备性和传递性）及单调性（相对于一阶随机占优）的基本/传统公理。与旨在检验独立性的实验研究不同，我们的实验更为全面，测试了EUT所依据的整套公理。我们的计量分析也是非参数的，并在每个个体受试者层面进行。对于绝大多数受试者而言，偏离独立性的程度相对于偏离排序和/或单调性的程度较小。

title: International Reserve Management Under Rollover Crises
title_zh: 滚动危机下的国际储备管理
title_primary: 滚动危机下的国际储备管理
title_secondary: International Reserve Management Under Rollover Crises
authors: Mauricio Barbosa-Alves, Javier Bianchi, César Sosa-Padilla
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-12 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This article investigates how a government should manage international reserves when it faces the risk of a rollover crisis. We ask: Should the government accumulate reserves or reduce debt to make itself less vulnerable? We show that the optimal policy entails initially reducing debt, followed by a subsequent increase in both debt and reserves as the government approaches a safe zone. Furthermore, we find that issuing additional debt to accumulate reserves can lead to a reduction in sovereign spreads. Evidence from a panel of emerging economies is consistent with these predictions: increases in reserves financed by public external borrowing are associated with lower spreads, and reserve holdings are not systematically drawn down during crisis episodes.
abstract_zh: 本文研究政府面临展期危机风险时应如何管理国际储备。我们提出的问题是：政府应通过积累储备还是减少债务来降低自身脆弱性？研究表明，最优政策路径是先减少债务，随后在政府接近安全区域时同步增加债务与储备。此外，我们发现通过增发债务来积累储备可降低主权利差。来自新兴经济体的面板数据与这些预测一致：由公共外部借款融资的储备增加与利差下降相关，且危机期间储备持有量并未系统性减少。

title: Digital dividend or digital divide? The differential impact of digital literacy on labour productivity
title_zh: 数字红利还是数字鸿沟？数字素养对劳动生产率的差异化影响
title_primary: 数字红利还是数字鸿沟？数字素养对劳动生产率的差异化影响
title_secondary: Digital dividend or digital divide? The differential impact of digital literacy on labour productivity
authors: Chunying Mao Minchun Han Lei Huang School of Economics, Huazhong University of Science and Technology, Wuhan, China
official: 官方在线 2025-08-03 · 来源：RSS
abstract: With the advancement of the digital economy, digital literacy has become a crucial component of human capital, necessitating in-depth research into its impact on labour productivity and the underlying mechanisms. Utilizing data from the China Family Panel Studies (CFPS), this research examines the effects of digital literacy on individual labour productivity and analyzes the moderating role of educational level. The findings indicate that digital literacy significantly enhances individual labour productivity, but this effect is significantly moderated by education levels. As education levels increase, the impact of digital literacy on labour productivity becomes more significant. Mechanism analyses reveal that digital literacy enhances labour productivity through three main pathways: facilitating transitions into digital occupations, reducing skill mismatches, and improving employment probabilities. These pathways are also moderated by education levels. Further analysis of different types of digital literacy reveals that, in comparison to productive digital literacy, the impact of living digital literacy on labour productivity is more dependent on individual education. Heterogeneity analysis indicates significant variations in the effects of digital literacy on labour productivity across regions with varying levels of digital technology development and between urban and rural areas.
abstract_zh: 随着数字经济的发展，数字素养已成为人力资本的重要组成部分，深入研究其对劳动生产率的影响及内在机制显得尤为必要。本研究利用中国家庭追踪调查（CFPS）数据，考察了数字素养对个人劳动生产率的影响，并分析了教育水平的调节作用。研究发现，数字素养显著提升个人劳动生产率，但这一效应受到教育水平的显著调节。随着教育水平的提高，数字素养对劳动生产率的影响愈发显著。机制分析表明，数字素养通过三条主要途径增强劳动生产率：促进向数字职业的转变、减少技能错配以及提高就业概率。这些途径同样受到教育水平的调节。对不同类型数字素养的进一步分析显示，相较于生产性数字素养，生活性数字素养对劳动生产率的影响更依赖于个人教育水平。异质性分析表明，在数字技术发展水平不同的地区以及城乡之间，数字素养对劳动生产率的影响存在显著差异。
